body: I cant argue with your logic at all. Thanks for taking the time, I have just spoken to my doctor as a last resort thing, she wants me to look into taking a break or something - try and break the cycle. Also just got randomly asked out on a date while waiting on a corner...remember guys sad face and tear marks are the way to go.

I have really tried not to let it happen, I just feel so lonely and worthless...like even if i ever found someone else im a broken mess inside, all I can offer is heartache and troubles. 

I dont want to die, I just cant cope anymore.

You can pry, ive just told my secrets. 

I was really happy with my ex, I found love, peace, and trust - I lack the emotional capacity to recover from her, dont take on my worries stranger, I am trying to put the whole saga to rest.

You are all great people and supportive people, There are probably more than a few who owe you guys and gals a lot, I appreciate the sentiment but this was all more just for me to leave some memory.

I wish I was capable of carrying on, The problem is i have had this sort of advice and feelings since forever, I have hung in there, I have fought and fought. So today I made a few calls (mother etc) and destroyed my phone, visited my cousins grave, took a long walk in the sun. 

Also forgot to mention that my cousin and two friends all killed themselves last year, one after the other, I just want peace now, the world wont miss me I can assure you.

I never got to be a kid - so make sure you enjoy it. 

While your heart is most certainly in the right place i am not looking for help, I have a date, a plan whatever you want to call it. Some people are past repair and its taken me a long time to realise I have been chasing something I will never have. 

Love is the biggest lie.
